label: Plant floor PLCs
info: Three filler lines, three sites. Plant 7 is a 2009 retrofit whose PLC uses a different register map (Fahrenheit, word-swapped counter, different state codes) -- the snowflake the Edge segment normalises away.

label: SAP ERP + 3PL API
info: SAP ECC sends ORDERS05 IDocs to the Hub. The Hub calls the 3PL fulfilment API below (POST /api/3pl/shipments), which the control panel can take down to show retry and backlog behaviour.

label: Field units (cellular)
info: 24 remote monitoring units on cellular links across three basins. They report every 5 s, drop off the network now and then, and apply flow updates with a realistic landing delay. FU-017 is an older rev A board: v2.4.0 breaks its sensor decode, which is the unit the Fleet presenter rolls back.

label: Presenter control panel
info: Dashboard at /dashboard. Every fault the webinar needs is one click here.
